label: AIOX Research Ecosystem
topology: tri-component (Squad + Skill + App) operating as one product

squad_research.role: Cognitive brain — orchestration, persona, methodology, governance

domain_model.Strategic: Posicionamento competitivo, inteligência de mercado e decisões de benchmark
domain_model.Tactical: Orquestração de benchmarks, síntese de evidências e análise comparativa
domain_model.Operational: Coleta, transcrição, publicação e automação de artefatos

checkpoints.threshold: coverage >= 70% APPROVE / <50 VETO halt after 3 waves

app_research_observatory.name: aiox-research
app_research_observatory.stack: Next.js 16.2.6 (App Router, webpack) + React 19.2.3 + Tailwind v4 + TypeScript 5 strict

features.research_execution: Create research runs in docs/research/ using local CLIs auto-detected or OpenRouter CLI
features.observatory_browse: Render Markdown/YAML/JSON artifacts from docs/research, docs/bench, outputs/sinkra-squad

tiers.AIOX Pro: Demo + Research + Bench + SINKRA Maps pointing to workspace

features.local_first: Reads filesystem directly; no DB required for read-only mode

ecosystem_strengths: Methodology governance: COVERAGE_GATE + CITATION_GATE are real, not aspirational
Incremental learning log on every phase (vs post-hoc only)
Multi-mode: tech-research, competitive intel, product discovery, benchmarking, marketing deep-dive
PT-BR/LatAm-first positioning with workflow verticals (PRD/BMC/battle-card grade)
Local-first: app reads filesystem, no DB required for read-only mode
9 dedicated bench tasks for codebase comparison (bench-framework, bench-deep-compare, etc.)
Subagent inventory of 14 specialist personas (Booth, Creswell, Forsgren, Gilad, Klein, Sackett — academic methodology lineage)
Tight integration with rest of SINKRA Hub (entry agent, ecosystem-registry, learning logs)
MIT-style/AGPL-free internal stack — App is Elastic License v2 (commercial protection)
ecosystem_weaknesses: No Docker sandbox for code execution during research (vs DeerFlow, AutoResearchClaw)
No persistent cross-session memory (vs DeerFlow TIAMAT)
No native MCP server exposure (vs LangChain Open DR, GPT-Researcher)
App is Elastic License v2 (not OSI open-source) — community contribution friction
No real-time progressive skill loading (vs DeerFlow)
No public leaderboard score on Deep Research Bench / BrowseComp-Plus / SimpleQA
No headless API mode (run via skill invocation only, not REST/CLI standalone)
Citation verification gate exists but no native scholarly database integration (arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar — vs Local Deep Research's 10+ engines)
Multi-agent orchestration is inline persona-fidelity, not true parallel subagent spawn for the research itself (only for bench-comparison pipeline)
